schema: Model operating parameters, NOT benchmark scores. note: Why a supplement and not an edit to batch-08/14/21: hard rule #2 — the archive is evidence, and existing batches correctly record what their source said at capture. batch-14's qwen3.7-plus row carries open_weights/context_k as null because the AA API publishes neither; this batch reads the AA page (a different surface) that does. The values are uncontroversial and match the catalog: the Qwen Max and Plus lines are proprietary and serve a 1M context, corroborated by AA's own comparison page and independent reporting. The qwen3.8-max intelligence index (now 58 on AA) is deliberately NOT captured here — updating a catalog value is the AA-refresh workflow's job, not a provenance fix.
